This Msa Is Filed Under Section 54(2) Of Land
Acquisition Act, Praying To Set Aside The Judgment
And Award Dated 11.7.2018 Passed By The Iii

Laca.No.76/2018 Modifying Judgment And Award Dated

 This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
Judgment Was Delivered Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice M.G.S.Kamal
 Oral Judgment
(Per: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice M.G.S.Kamal) The appellants/beneficiaries are before this Court
being aggrieved by the order dated 11.07.2018 passed in Laca No.76/2018 by the Iii Additional
District Judge at Kalaburagi (hereinafter referred to as 'Appellate Court' for short) by which, the
Appellate Court while partly allowing Nc: 2024:Khc-K:9606 the appeal modifying the award dated
07.04.2015 passed by the court of the Senior Civil Judge, Aland (hereinafter referred to as
'Reference Court' for short) in Lac No.156/2013 had enhanced the compensation amount in respect
of the acquired wet land at `6,57,054/- per acre from `2,62,500/-.
2.

The subject matter of the acquisition is the agricultural land in Sy.No.28/2 measuring 15 guntas situated at Jawali (D) of Aland Taluk, District Kalaburagi which was acquired by issuing notification The Executive Engineer And Anr vs Chandrasha S/O Veerabhadappa Dead By ... on 12 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/104423754/
2 dated 05.02.2009 for Amarja project.

entities.text: Executive Engineer And Anr vs Chandrasha S/O Veerabhadappa Dead By
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The Special Land Acquisition Officer had passed the award dated 15.02.2011 fixing the market value at `50,000/- per acre.
Upon reference, the Reference Court enhanced the same to `2,62,500/- per acre based on capitalization method.

Aggrieved by the same,
the claimants preferred the appeal before the First Appellate Court in LACA No.76/2018.
The First Appellate Court relying upon the judgment and award passed in LACA No.347/2016 and LACA No.348/2016 NC: 2024:KHC-K:9606 enhanced the market value of the land at `6,57,054/- per acre.

3. The learned counsel for the appellants submits that the award that was passed in LACA No.347/2016 and LACA No.348/2016 fixing the compensation `6,57,054/- per acre of wet land has been paid and satisfied by the respondents/claimants and there has been no challenge to the same.
Learned counsel however submits that the LACA Court while enhancing the compensation has taken the rate of de-escalation at 3% per annum which has to be 5%.
Calculated as such, the compensation payable would be `6,57,054/- instead of `6,43,507.5.

4. Learned counsel for the appellants relying upon the judgment dated 18.07.2024 passed in MSA No.200103/2024 in the case of EXECUTIVE ENGINEER AND ANOTHER vs. LAXMAN AND OTHERS submits that the present case is covered by the said order, in which this Court has reduced the rate of compensation from `6,57,054/- to `6,43,507.5/- in view of the judgment NC:
2024:KHC-K:9606 passed in the case of DIGAMBER S/O RAMRAO KULKARNI AND OTHERS vs.
THE DEPUTY COMMISSIONER, KALABURAGI AND OTHERS (in LACA Nos.347/2016 and 348/2016) wherein the acquisition was under the Notification dated 01.04.2010 for the similar purposes situated in the similar village.

entities.text: EXECUTIVE ENGINEER AND ANOTHER vs. LAXMAN AND OTHERS
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
DIGAMBER S/O RAMRAO KULKARNI AND OTHERS vs.
THE DEPUTY COMMISSIONER, KALABURAGI AND OTHERS
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that since there was difference of one year between the Notification subject matter of Digamber's case (supra) and Notification subject matter of said appeal, 5% de-escalation was granted thereby reducing the compensation paid as above.

5. He submits Appellate Court instead of taking 5% de-escalation had taken only 3% de-escalation and that if compensation awarded by the Appellate Court is reduced by taking 5% de-escalation purpose of filing of the appeal would be served.
He further submits that the compensation awarded in MSA No.200103/2024 has already been paid and satisfied and same has attained finality.
Learned counsel for the respondent/claimant does not dispute the aforesaid factual aspect of the matter.

Since the order in MSA No.200103/2024 is passed in respect of the very same Notification dated 05.02.2009 in respect of the land which is situated in Jawali-D village, Aland Taluk,
Kalaburagi District, this Court do not see any reason to differ from the rate of compensation awarded in MSA No.200103/2024.
7.

In that view of the matter, pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is partly allowed.

3 ii)

sentences.text: The rate of compensation is modified and reduced from `6,57,054/- to `6,43,507.5 payable with all statutory benefits.

(1) It is made clear that if there be any delay by respondent/claimant in preferring the appeal before the First Appellate Court the same NC: 2024:KHC-K:9606 should be excluded for calculation of interest on the compensation.
In view of disposal of main appeal, pending IA, if any, does not survive for consideration and same shall be disposed of.
